pages.text: The Storage Monitor is a block that displays the amount of a specific item or fluid in your storage network. In RS2, it provides enhanced visual indicators and improved real-time updates of resource levels.

Features:$(li)Enhanced display of item or fluid quantities$(li)Improved real-time updates$(li)Configurable display item$(li)Enhanced redstone output based on quantity$(li)Better comparator integration

To use the Storage Monitor:$(li)Place it within range of your Controller$(li)Connect it to your network using cables$(li)Right-click to configure$(li)Set the item or fluid to monitor$(li)Configure redstone output if desired
